subject: Time-sensitive: candidate comp appeal and expedite for Sofia Morales
messages:
From: Ravi Patel <ravi.patel@talentbridge.io>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Sofia Morales — verbal competing offer

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Quick heads-up: Sofia (Senior Platform Engineer, final-stage with Redwood) just got a verbal competing offer from Nimbus Analytics. They surfaced a base + equity package that is roughly 12% above our current band for the req (REQ-4832) and are asking for a decision window of 72 hours. Sofia is strongly leaning to stay for role fit here but is asking if Redwood can move on either base or a signing premium.

She asked me to check whether there is headcount room for an uplift or a one-time sign-on to bridge. Candidate is high-priority — strong infra background and relevant production inference experience.

I can pass along any revised terms if you want to try to match or counter.

Ravi
TalentBridge — Senior Recruiter
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Sofia Morales — verbal competing offer

Marissa — thanks for the flag. Sofia is one of the few candidates we had that checks the reliability + latency experience box. If Nimbus is 12% higher on base, I don't want to chase base beyond comp bands unless we get sign-off. Options to consider:

- Use a one-time signing bonus (from comp reserves) to bridge the delta (less disruptive to band).
- Offer a slightly higher equity tranche vesting acceleration (fastest ok if approved).
- If Jonas signs off, allow a temporary band uplift for this hire only (precedent to be noted).

Immediate asks: can we get an approval for up to $25k signing bonus or a $15k signing + modest base bump? If headcount / comp reserves are blockers, prioritize the one-time sign-on. Candidate needs an answer within 72 hours. Can you engage Sofia with a tight counter so we don't lose momentum?

Jonas / Lauren — can you weigh in on approvals? If you prefer the signing route I can draft the numbers and rationale.

—Karthik
Staff, Recruiting Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@gmail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-14T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer from Redwood — counter & timeline

Sofia — appreciate the transparency and congrats again on the strong offer from Nimbus. We remain very excited about you joining Redwood. I wanted to be transparent about what we can move on quickly while I secure internal approvals.

What I can offer you right now (pending final approvals):
- Maintain the base in the existing band, plus a one-time signing bonus of $25,000 (gross) paid on first paycheck.
- Accelerated equity vesting: 50% of the first-year tranche vests at 6 months (subject to final compensation committee sign-off).

This package keeps base band integrity but closes most of the cash gap. It is contingent on approval from our comp owner — I am escalating for an answer within 24 hours so we can respect Nimbus's timeline. If you'd prefer to prioritize higher base instead of sign-on, tell me and I'll push that option (it takes longer to approve).

If you want to talk this through now, I have a 30-min slot at 2:30pm — I can call.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-15T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Comp approval request — Sofia Morales

Forwarding: Marissa has requested a $25k sign-on to match a competitor and accelerate acceptance. I reviewed the file (REQ-4832) and candidate notes — Sofia is high impact and hard to find for on-prem inference + production KV cache work.

Decision: Approve a $25,000 one-time signing bonus from the comp reserve for this hire. Do not approve an out-of-band permanent base uplift without a formal comp committee memo. We should keep base inside band to avoid setting precedent; sign-on and accelerated vesting is the right mix.

Action items:
- Marissa: proceed to finalize the offer and add the sign-on language (gross $25,000, paid on first payroll).
- Karthik: confirm headcount remains for REQ-4832 in PEOPLEOPS (Lauren) and mark as approved in Greenhouse.

Jonas
VP, Engineering (hiring approver)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Morales <sofia.morales@gmail.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-16T18:01:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized offer — Redwood Inference

Sofia — great news. We have final approvals. Please find the attached offer packet: offer_letter_sofia_morales.pdf and comp_worksheet_REQ-4832.xlsx. Summary of the finalized terms below (numbers reflect gross amounts):

- Title: Senior Platform Engineer
- Base salary: $195,000 (within band)
- Signing bonus: $25,000 (one-time, paid on first payroll)
- Equity: 0.65%; first-year tranche accelerated per earlier note (50% at 6 months) — final vest schedule in the offer doc.
- Start date: flexible within 4–6 weeks; we can accommodate earlier notice if needed.

Next steps:
1) Sign the DocuSign packet (link: https://docusign.com/abcdef-12345) and we'll route to People Ops.
2) I'll confirm payroll timing for the sign-on once you sign.

If this looks good, please sign today or tomorrow to meet Nimbus's deadline — we want to lock this. If you have any questions we can hop on a quick call tonight.

Attachments: offer_letter_sofia_morales.pdf (PDF, 62KB), comp_worksheet_REQ-4832.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

Welcome — we hope to have you on board soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
Attachments: offer_letter_sofia_morales.pdf; comp_worksheet_REQ-4832.xlsx
